name: Primex Auto Repair Workshop
address: Industrial Areas - Industrial Area - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Primex Auto Repair Workshop – trusted since 1996 for affordable, reliable, and expert car care. From quick maintenance to major repairs, our skilled team keeps your car running smooth, safe, and worry-free. Drive in today and feel the difference!

reviews.author: Rajabtrd Sharjah
reviews.text:
I gave my vehicle for repair, and I am very satisfied with the service provided. The repair work was completed professionally, and the quality of the work exceeded my expectations. The staff was friendly, cooperative, and kept me informed throughout the process. They delivered my vehicle on time, and everything was handled smoothly. I highly recommend their excellent service to anyone looking for reliable vehicle repairs.

Thank you, Primex Auto Workshop, for your excellent service, professionalism, and dedication. I truly appreciate your hard work and wish your team continued success.

reviews.author: Steve Odinga
reviews.text:
I recently took my car to Primex Garage through Fujairah Insurance after a small incident, and I had a very positive experience. The staff were professional, and the customer service was excellent from start to finish. Sam and Mr. Amil were especially helpful, keeping me informed and making the whole process smooth and stress-free.

The car was fixed within one day, and the paintwork matched the original perfectly, it looks as good as new. Highly recommended for anyone looking for fast, reliable, and professional service.

reviews.text:

I live in Al Ain and it is worth taking my car all the way to Sharja for their service. I know the car is the in the best hands and I have not enough words to say thank you and highly recommend it.
Thank you once again Sam for the most professional service.

reviews.author: Mohammed
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Primex Garage and their owner Sam. The team is very professional, knowledgeable, and honest. Their service charges are fair and transparent, which is hard to find these days.

They diagnosed and fixed multiple issues in my car hyundai Sonata, including axle and steering problems, and the work was done properly without unnecessary upselling. The staff is cooperative and clearly knows what they’re doing.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable and trustworthy auto repair. I’ll definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: BINEESH PHILIP BIJU
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Primex Auto Repair Workshop, Not only did they provide top-notch repair services, but they also made the entire insurance process seamless. The staff guided me step-by-step, handled the paperwork efficiently, and coordinated with my insurance company to ensure everything was processed smoothly.

The repairs were completed on time, and they kept me updated throughout the process. The quality of the work was outstanding, and the pricing was transparent. If you're looking for a reliable workshop that also excels in handling insurance claims, I highly recommend Primex Auto Repair Workshop to anyone looking for reliable and efficient auto repair services in Sharjah!
